_comment: Pin of the upstream anomalyco/opencode binary release that the desktop app bundles for Mode C. Bump `version` to upgrade. The download URL is computed as https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/download/<version>/<asset> by scripts/copy-opencode-bin.mjs. SHA-256 sums are verified against this manifest at download time; update them in the same commit as the version bump.
